info.title: GovCon RMF, Continuous ATO (cATO), SSP & POA&M Generator API
info.description: Transforms RFP cybersecurity requirements and system architecture descriptions into a complete DoD RMF / FedRAMP / StateRAMP Authority to Operate (ATO) & Continuous ATO (cATO) Readiness Package, including FIPS 199 / Impact Level (IL2-IL6) boundary classification, tailored NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / NIST 800-171 System Security Plan (SSP) control implementation statements, an automated DevSecOps cATO pipeline blueprint (OSCAL, SBOM, STIG hardening), and a Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) remediation schedule.

post.summary: Generate RMF, Continuous ATO (cATO), SSP Controls & POA&M Package
post.description: Generates a complete Authority to Operate (ATO) / Continuous ATO (cATO) package with FIPS 199 / DISA IL categorization, NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 SSP control implementation narratives, DevSecOps cATO pipeline gates, and a structured POA&M remediation schedule.

200.description: Successfully generated ATO / RMF / SSP & POA&M readiness package.

rfp_security_and_ato_requirements.description: Raw text from RFP Section C/H/L/M detailing ATO, RMF (eMASS/Xacta), FedRAMP, StateRAMP, DISA Impact Level (IL4/IL5), NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, or CMMC Level 2 authorization requirements.
rfp_security_and_ato_requirements.example: SOLICITATION FA8732-26-R-0088 (USAF Cloud & Zero-Trust Mission Enclave): Section C.4.1 Cybersecurity & RMF Authorization: The Contractor shall achieve an Interim Authority to Test (IATT) within 45 days and a full DoD RMF Step 6 Authority to Operate (ATO) in eMASS at DISA Cloud Computing SRG Impact Level 5 (IL5) / FedRAMP High within 90 days of award. The Contractor shall deliver a NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 System Security Plan (SSP), Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) strategy, automated DevSecOps Continuous ATO (cATO) pipeline producing OSCAL and CycloneDX SBOM artifacts, and a Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) for any open CAT II/III findings.

system_architecture_and_boundary_context.description: Description of the bidder's cloud environment, hosting boundary, identity provider, encryption posture, DevSecOps toolchain, and any existing compliance gaps.
system_architecture_and_boundary_context.example: Hosted on AWS GovCloud (US-East/West) FedRAMP High & DoD IL5 inherited infrastructure. Containerized microservices on Amazon EKS hardened with DISA Kubernetes STIGs and Iron Bank base images. Identity via Okta FedRAMP High ICAM with CAC/PIV FIDO2 MFA. AES-256 AWS KMS FIPS 140-3 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Splunk Cloud SIEM with 365-day immutable S3 Object Lock audit logs. Known gap: Legacy reporting module currently uses TLS 1.2 non-FIPS OpenSSL library scheduled for FIPS module replacement in Sprint 2.

target_ato_timeline_days.description: Target calendar days from contract award to achieve full ATO / cATO authorization.

ato_readiness_score.description: Overall ATO / cATO readiness score from 0 to 100.
